storySlots.title: County clerk who called on Friday afternoon
storySlots.story: A clerk told me they got a new mandate from Little Rock and no training budget — they asked who at the Secretary of State will answer the phone. That's why I'm running this office as service.

storySlots.title: Petition volunteer turned away
storySlots.story: A volunteer described signature rules so tight they gave up a lawful petition drive — not fraud, confusion. Integrity and participation should work together.

storySlots.title: Quorum court member worried about unfunded mandate
storySlots.story: A quorum court member asked where the line item was for the newest election law — their clerk was told to comply first and ask questions later.

storySlots.title: Young voter first time participating
storySlots.story: A first-time voter said they wanted rules they could read online — not slogans. Transparency is a kitchen-table issue.

storySlots.title: Election worker overtime
storySlots.story: Poll workers described absorbing new procedures without extra staff — the Secretary of State should show up with training, not blame.
storySlots.whenToUse: Humanize county burden vs Hammer record
